title: Pest Control Service Call Intake Form
subtitle: Control inspection, monitoring, exclusion, treatment, and follow-up through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete pest control service call intake for treatment zones, devices, products, and pest observations. It connects approved pest plan, product label, and site authorization to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a pest-service coordinator must triage and route a new pest control request without promising scope before site, asset, hazard, access, and authorization facts are known.

blocks.guidance: Verify the full intake record before arrival and stop or escalate when target identification, product labeling, applicator qualification, occupant protection, weather, exposure, spill, or treatment boundary is uncertain.

sections.title: Pest Control intake exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, immediate protection, decision owner, deadline, and dispatch restriction reconstructable.

blocks.label: Pest Control exception and stop-work indicators
items: Target pest cannot be reliably identified
Product label, SDS, registration, or intended-use direction unavailable
Applicator credential or supervision requirement not satisfied
Child, pet, food, feed, medical, or other sensitive exposure unresolved
Wind, rain, temperature, runoff, pollinator, or water condition outside limits
PPE, first-aid, spill-response, or decontamination resources unavailable
Product spill, leak, damaged container, misapplication, or unintended exposure
Treatment area cannot be secured, ventilated, posted, or kept vacant as required
Observed organism, damage, or site condition requires another qualified discipline
Customer requests a rate, site, method, or reentry instruction outside labeling
blocks.guidance: Select the observed condition; do not use a generic exception when the actual trigger is known.

blocks.label: Exception containment, decision, and escalation register
Controlled hold or exception status

sections.title: Pest Control service call intake closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Remaining action and follow-up register
Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This pest control service call intake is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when target identification, product labeling, applicator qualification, occupant protection, weather, exposure, spill, or treatment boundary is uncertain. A pest-management compliance supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted
blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated outcome; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
